desc: Read K, S, T from stdin; output No if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K.
Trim common prefix then common suffix (non-overlapping); short-circuit when a trimmed string is empty.
Implement farthest-reaching wavefront DP over diagonals d in [-K,K] with substitution/deletion/insertion transitions plus LCP extension; test reach of (n,m) on diagonal ds=n-m.
Replace char-by-char LCP with 64-bit rolling-hash + binary-search LCP; samples pass (all 3 public samples PASSED).
Differential-test vs brute-force Levenshtein DP on many random small inputs and constructed boundary cases; verdicts agree, no counterexample found.
Verify worst-case path is acceptable (O(n+m+K² log n) time, O(n+m+K) memory) and submission confirmed by passing all public samples.
